title: An affine-defect test for Newtonian motions
exact_target: Find n-body motions in a fixed affine class beyond relative equilibria and the named symmetric examples.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002544 (AIM-PHYSICS-0052). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Variational Methods in Celestial Mechanics; notes by Kuo-Chang Chen, version 22 June 2003, source item 15.

status_qualification: The source leaves affine-map admissibility and the excluded class of symmetric solutions informal. Those ambiguities are retained visibly rather than equating every affine class with a similarity class. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
